mechanics.title: Basic Climbing
mechanics.description: Grab onto designated wall surfaces, mantle up, etc.

mechanics.title: Leap to Adjacent Wall
mechanics.description: Jump from a climbing surface to a nearby one.

mechanics.title: Helping Hand
mechanics.description: Extend a hand to pull a friend up.

mechanics.title: Double-Tap 180
mechanics.description: Quickly turn around while climbing by double-tapping backwards.

mechanics.title: GREAT Movement
mechanics.description: Iterate until the character feels fun to control in a greybox.

mechanics.title: Crouch, Push / Pull
mechanics.description: Useful for puzzles, challenges, and general agency.

mechanics.title: Stamina Burn
mechanics.description: Exceed max stamina — but doing so deals permanent damage.

mechanics.title: Fall-Damage Telegraph
mechanics.description: Project where they will fall and play SFX/VFX to telegraph the damage.

mechanics.title: Climbing Art / Effects
mechanics.description: Juiced animations and sound effects for basic climbing.

mechanics.title: Climbing Camera
mechanics.description: Camera framing that reads walls and holds well during climbs.

mechanics.title: Photo Mode
mechanics.description: Pause and frame a shot of your climb.

mechanics.title: Animated Faces
mechanics.description: Mouth/expression changes with voice input and world feedback.

mechanics.title: Racials
mechanics.description: Passive/active ability per animal race (Dog Howl: stamina boost; Cat Claws: slower stamina drain on a wall).

mechanics.title: Ghost Mode
mechanics.description: When dead and waiting for resurrection, spectate, speak to teammates, or troll.

mechanics.title: Proximity Voice Chat
mechanics.description: Spatialised voice; drives Animated Faces and co-op coordination.

mechanics.title: Interaction System
mechanics.description: Interact with objects that can't be picked up (pull a lever, open a door).
